policies.title: Policy Setup
policies.description: Define your pricing, returns, and damage policies for vendors and customers.
policies.pricingHint: Set your rates for each fulfilment model. At least one must be enabled.
policies.storageHint: Applies when you warehouse the vendor's stock.
policies.pickupHint: Applies when you collect from the vendor and deliver to the customer.
policies.additionalFeesHint: Applied on top of either active model when conditions apply.
policies.codHandlingFeeInfo: Cash on Delivery fee — charged when a customer pays cash upon delivery. Covers the cost of collecting, handling, and remitting cash payments.
policies.returnsNotesPlaceholder: E.g. only unopened items accepted, unboxing video required…
policies.damageNotesPlaceholder: E.g. original packaging required, claims without video rejected…

info.monthlyStorageFee: Monthly fee per unique product (SKU) stored in your warehouse. Example: 10 SKUs × 500 XAF = 5,000 XAF/month. Leave blank to default to 0.
info.pickPackFee: Fee charged each time you pick, pack, and prepare an order for shipment. Example: 300 XAF per completed order. Leave blank to default to 0.
info.localDeliveryFee: Flat fee for deliveries within your primary coverage region. Example: 1,500 XAF for any order delivered in the same region. Leave blank to default to 0.
info.outOfRegionDeliveryFee: Fee for orders shipped outside your primary region. Example: 3,000 XAF for a package sent from Littoral to Centre. Leave blank to default to 0.
info.baseRateFirstKg: Base charge for the first kilogram of any pickup-and-deliver shipment. Example: 1,000 XAF covers any package up to 1 kg. Leave blank to default to 0.
info.additionalPerKg: Extra charge for each kg beyond the first. Example: 200 XAF/kg — a 3 kg parcel costs 1,000 + 400 = 1,400 XAF total. Leave blank to default to 0.
info.outOfRegionSurcharge: Surcharge added when a pickup delivery goes outside your primary region. Example: 500 XAF on top of the weight-based rate. Leave blank to default to 0.
info.codFeeType: How the COD fee is calculated — as a percentage of the order total, or a flat fixed amount in XAF.
info.codFeeValue: The COD fee amount. For Percentage: enter 2 for 2%. For Fixed: enter the XAF amount (e.g. 500). Leave blank to default to 0.
info.failedDeliveryFee: Fee charged to the vendor when a delivery attempt fails (e.g. customer unavailable or unreachable). Example: 500 XAF per failed attempt. Leave blank to default to 0.
info.rtoFee: Return-to-origin fee charged when a package is sent back to the vendor after all delivery attempts fail. Example: 800 XAF per RTO shipment. Leave blank to default to 0.
info.peakSeasonSurcharge: Optional extra charge applied during high-demand periods (e.g. December holidays). Example: 200 XAF added to every delivery in that period. Set to 0 if not applicable.
info.returnsPayer: Who bears the cost of shipping and processing a returned order. Vendor = merchants pay; Agency = you absorb it; Customer = buyer pays.
info.handlingFee: Fee charged to process each return — covers logistics, inspection, and re-shelving. Example: 500 XAF per returned order. Leave blank to default to 0.
info.returnWindow: How many days after delivery a return request can be accepted. Example: 7 means customers have 7 days from delivery to initiate a return. Leave blank to default to 0.
info.claimDeadline: Maximum days after delivery to file a damage claim. Example: 3 means damage must be reported within 3 days of receipt. Leave blank to default to 0.
info.maxRefundPerItem: Maximum compensation you will pay per damaged item, regardless of its value. Example: a 10,000 XAF cap means a 50,000 XAF item is refunded up to 10,000 XAF. Leave blank to default to 0.
info.codEnabled: Whether your agency accepts cash-on-delivery orders at all. When off, customers can't place COD orders whose shipments you would carry. This is separate from the COD handling fee above, which only applies once COD is on.
info.codMaxAmount: Optional cap on a single COD order's total. Checkout rejects COD orders above this amount. Leave blank for no cap.
